d:
Pitri paksh ki satvik thali — khir se masala puri tak
27 sitanbar–10 aktubar 2026: 5 resipi, bina pyaz-lahsun, bina jhanjhat parphekta.
chaval ki khir — kesar, ilaychi ke sath
arbi makhane ka jhol — bina chipke banane ki trik
urad dal se masala puri, toraee aur aalu tamatar ki sabji
Comment karein — aapke ghar thali mein aur kya banta hai? Zaroor bataiye
